name: Empty states teach
rule: An empty state says why it's empty and what will show up here. It offers one clear next step.

leaders.note: A short, upbeat title and body copy say what would appear and why it's empty. One primary action leads, with an optional docs link.
The title names what is missing. The description says when data shows up, and the action label echoes the title. Filtered-out results get different copy.
